llm_response.reason: The website displays several scam characteristics: (1) It claims to sell Russell & Bromley branded products, but the domain name (lisaogaz.shop) does not match the real Russell & Bromley site, indicating impersonation. (2) No verifiable company, phone number, or business email is provided—contact is only possible via a generic webform, failing to meet professional standards. (3) Psychological tactics are used, promising '100% Secure Shopping' and 'Free Shipping over €60.' (4) SSL certificate issues further suggest poor security. These characteristics strongly align with fake online shopping scams.
